layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-8, py-24, gap-12 to ensure breathing room.
layout.grid_strategy: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid) for Gallery and Services. Asymmetric column spans.

components.hero: Full-bleed image or smooth crossfade slider. Hero overlay: bg-black/30 or gradient-to-t from-emerald-900/60. Text left-aligned with a metallic accent line.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-emerald-900 text-white rounded-none hover:bg-emerald-800 transition-colors. Secondary: border border-emerald-900 text-emerald-900 rounded-none hover:bg-emerald-50 transition-colors.
components.cards: Cardless or flat background (bg-white) with 1px border-emerald-900/10. No heavy shadows. Subtle lift on hover.
components.whatsapp_float: Sticky bottom-right. Glassmorphism pill shape. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-white/20 shadow-lg text-emerald-900. Contains WhatsApp and Phone icons.

motion.entrance: Fade up with Framer Motion (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1, duration: 0.6).
motion.hover: Images subtly scale up (scale: 1.05) within hidden overflow containers.
